scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project backend --frozen python -m meal_prep.bootstrap.export_schema --output contracts/openapi.json && node apps/web/scripts/contracts.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --project backend --frozen python -m meal_prep.bootstrap.export_schema --check --output contracts/openapi.json && node apps/web/scripts/contracts.mjs --check
scripts.test:contracts: uv run --project backend --frozen pytest backend/tests/test_contract_wire.py -q --junitxml=.artifacts/wire-pytest.xml && python3 scripts/check-test-report.py .artifacts/wire-pytest.xml && pnpm --filter @meal-prep/web exec vitest run --config vitest.contracts.config.ts --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile=../../.artifacts/wire-vitest.xml && python3 scripts/check-test-report.py .artifacts/wire-vitest.xml
